decision.explanation: The query 'When was Harry Harvey born?' refers to a name shared by multiple distinct individuals found in the source documents. D1S1/D1S2 identify Harry Harvey (Medal of Honor, 1865) as born on December 14, 1846. D2S1/D2S7 identify Harry Harvey (Medal of Honor, 1901) as born on June 4, 1873. D3S3 identifies Harry Harvey Sr. (the actor) as born on January 10, 1901. The prompt instructions explicitly state that distinct valid namesakes may coexist and that competing assertions about one referent are not automatically distinct valid answers, but here the sources clearly distinguish three different people (Civil War soldier, Marine, Actor) with different birth dates. All three dates are valid answers corresponding to their respective entities.
